convert_yoso_checkpoint: convert a YOSO original repository checkpoint to HuggingFace transformers format using a config file and output path
convert_checkpoint_helper: convert a YOSO state dict by renaming keys and filtering out pooler and sen_class entries
rename_key: rename YOSO checkpoint keys to match HuggingFace YosoForMaskedLM naming conventions
run_convert_cli: run the YOSO checkpoint conversion CLI with pytorch model path, config file, and dump path arguments
review_convert_yoso_checkpoint: review the convert_yoso_checkpoint function that loads, transforms, and saves a YOSO model checkpoint
